summary:
Full-stack review of the 3 new features: (1) inline KYC step on /create-pay-link setup guard, (2) POST /api/user/activation-nudge with server-side gate re-check, (3) per-page OG share images for /fees /about /how-to /blog. ALL 8 scenarios PASS.

BACKEND (pytest, 14/14 passed, JUnit @ /app/test_reports/pytest/activation_nudge_og.xml):
  * POST /api/user/activation-nudge auth'd: {gate:'brand'} -> 200 sent:false reason:'gate_not_open'; {gate:'wallet',company_id:1} -> 200 gate_not_open; {gate:'kyc',company_id:1} -> 200 gate_not_open; {gate:'bogus'} -> 400 with message 'gate must be one of brand, wallet, kyc'; no Authorization header -> 401 (Unauthorized). Server-side gate re-check works — merchant has all gates satisfied so nothing is sent even if the client asks.
  * SEO og:image + twitter:image on /fees /about /how-to /blog all resolve to https://dynopay.com/og/{route}.png; / falls back to /og/dynopay-og.png. Each /og/*.png is served 200 image/png with real dimensions 1200x630 (verified by reading PNG IHDR).

FRONTEND (Playwright, viewport 1920x900, 2-step login onarrival21@gmail.com):
  Baseline /create-pay-link (no interception, real merchant has company+wallet+kyc-not-required): normal form renders, no data-testid=payment-link-setup-guard, no KycGraceBanner, and no /api/user/activation-nudge POST. GET /api/kyc/status is called (observed 2 requests on /create-pay-link with company_id=1 — see minor note below).
  KYC BLOCKED gate (kyc/status intercepted to blocked=true, grace.blocked=true, days_remaining=0): data-testid=payment-link-setup-guard visible with data-gate='kyc'; title 'Verify your identity to keep getting paid'; subtitle mentions '$10,000' and '90-day grace period'; step 'Create a Company' shows 'Done'; step 'Add a Payout Wallet' shows 'Done'; step 'Verify your identity' shows helper 'Required — you've passed $10,000 in payment volume. Takes ~5 minutes.'; payment-link form NOT rendered as a page (only chrome). Exactly one POST /api/user/activation-nudge fired with body {gate:'kyc', company_id:1}. After reload the nudge did NOT fire again — sessionStorage key dp:activation-nudge:kyc dedup works. Zero console errors.
  KYC step click: with kyc/submit intercepted 200 {verification_url:'https://example.com/veriff-session'}, clicking [data-testid=setup-guard-step-kyc] fires exactly one POST /api/kyc/submit and window.location navigates to https://example.com/veriff-session (route intercepted so no real Veriff session is created).
  KYC GRACE (blocked:false, days_remaining:42): normal payment-link form renders AND data-testid=kyc-grace-banner appears above it with data-kyc-blocked='false' and data-testid=kyc-grace-days text '42 days to verify your identity'. NO /api/user/activation-nudge POST fires (guard is not shown in grace mode). setup-guard is absent as expected.
  Dashboard regression: with the same grace mock, /dashboard renders and shows data-testid=kyc-grace-banner (data-kyc-blocked='false', days text '42 days to verify your identity'), confirming KycGraceBanner is on the shared useKycGate hook. No console errors.
  WALLET gate (real kyc/status, wallet/getWallet intercepted to empty list): data-testid=payment-link-setup-guard visible with data-gate='wallet'; title 'A couple of quick steps first'; step 'Create a Company' shows 'Done'; step 'Add a Payout Wallet' is visible/clickable; NO KYC step rendered (kyc not required for this merchant). Clicking setup-guard-step-wallet opens the AddWalletModal (MUI dialog present); Escape closes it cleanly without adding a wallet (no DB write). Exactly one POST /api/user/activation-nudge with body {gate:'wallet', company_id:1}.

SAFETY: All destructive scenarios were produced via Playwright route interception — no companies, wallets, payment links or KYC sessions were created against the live prod DB. Outbound email is suppressed at the pod level (DISABLE_OUTBOUND_EMAIL=true).
critical_code_review_comments: MINOR — Baseline observed 2x GET /api/kyc/status?company_id=1 on /create-pay-link (task spec said 'once'). Root cause: useKycGate keys SWR on ['kyc/status/full', companyId ?? 'self']; on initial render companyId is undefined and it fires with no params, then re-fires when selectedCompanyId hydrates to 1. Not a functional bug (SWR dedups within dedupingInterval=60000 for the same key), but a small extra request per session. Optional: gate the SWR call behind `companyId != null` (or add `if (!companyId) return null` in the fetcher and let SWR return undefined) so no request fires until the companyId is known.
activationNudge controller: `Number(userData.user_id)` is fine but consider explicit isNaN guard (defensive). Not a blocker.
create-pay-link.tsx line 62 computes `payload` but never uses it before calling refetchWallets(); harmless dead code but worth removing.
test_credentials: onarrival21@gmail.com / Katiekendra123@ (2-step login: email -> Continue -> password -> Sign in). Backend accessToken via POST /api/user/login for pytest.
seed_data_creation: none — read-only session, all gate mutations via Playwright route interception.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wallet list endpoint used by useWalletStore.refetchWallets is GET /api/wallet/getWallet?company_id=<id> (WALLET_KEY constant in /app/contexts/WalletDataContext.tsx, res.data.data is the array). To force hasWallet=false intercept with {message:'ok', data:[]}. useKycGate SWR key is ['kyc/status/full', companyId ?? 'self'], dedupingInterval 60000, revalidateIfStale=false — a full page.goto is required to reset. sessionStorage key `dp:activation-nudge:<gate>` dedups the nudge for the session. Backend cold-start on this pod returns 503 'Backend starting, please retry' for ~15s after supervisor restart; retry the login call.
